notes.title: Castlebound New Demo!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]First of all, we want to thank everyone who has taken the time to give [b]Castlebound[/b] a try![/p][p]Thanks to the feedback, we decided to improve the demo![/p][p][/p][p]We have uploaded a new [b]v0.2.3[/b] with the following improvements:[/p][list][*][p][b]Game pacing improvement[/b]: We removed a lot of unnecessary waits that were breaking the game pacing and made it more continuous.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Choose your path changed[/b]: We have changed the way players can choose their path inside the run by offering two options after a slot is finished. Here, we are showing what kind of enemies will be faced and the type of reward that will be received if the next slot is completed[/p][/*][*][p][b]New power up in level up[/b]: Now, each time a Hero is leveling up, they will receive a power up that will boost their stats![/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved overall game balance[/b]: Yeah, we re-balanced the entire demo, now it should feel better![/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544519/e24a98ffcdb617d1240e1f7aa4c21b89f403d9e6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you all enjoy this new demo![/p][p][/p][p]Please leave your feedback in the Community Discussion or on our Discord: [url="https://discord.me/ogrepixel"]https://discord.me/ogrepixel[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551820/Castlebound/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings![/p][p][/p][p][b]Steve[/b][/p][p]Ogre Pixel[/p][p][url="https://ogrepixel.com"][b]www.ogrepixel.com[/b][/url][/p]

notes.title: New Demo version 0.1.7 and Remote Play Together activated!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone! We hope you all are great[/p][p]We are happy to share that we have been working hard on improving the [b]Castlebound[/b] Demo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544519/e3805dfac905efc20c2f3b5a4607f10fa2472a97.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Latest v0.1.7 has the following upgrades:[/p][list][*][p]Player controller improved![/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay is more fun (more enemies coming)![/p][/*][*][p]Now it is easy to add/remove players for Multiplayer mode[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bugs and improvements![/p][/*][/list][p]*The game works great on Steam Deck[/p][p][b]We have also enabled the Remote Play Together feature on Steam and it works great![/b][/p][p][/p][p]It is better to play with game controllers and there is no need for all the players who are playing through Remote Player Together to have the demo installed. Only the host has to have the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue working on the Demo so please keep updating it.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551820/Castlebound/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Greetings![/p][p][/p][p]Steve[/p][p]Ogre Pixel[/p][p][url="https://ogrepixel.com"]www.ogrepixel.com[/url][/p]

notes.title: Defend your moving castle in the demo for Castlebound
notes.notes:
Castlebound from Ogre Pixel now has a demo available to try on Steam, so you can defend your moving castle in this cute looking action roguelike.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/defend-your-moving-castle-in-the-demo-for-castlebound/

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We are happy to share that finally we have a Demo for [b]Castlebound[/b]![/p][p]To celebrate we created a new Trailer, here it is, we hope you like it[/p][previewyoutube="nnLDi7myvvU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Please consider giving the demo a try and share your feedback and comments! That helps a lot![/b][/p][p]Aaaand if you like it please [b]wishlist it[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551820/Castlebound/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Steve[/p][p]Ogre Pixel[/p][p][url="https://ogrepixel.com"]www.ogrepixel.com[/url][/p]

notes.title: Get ready to defend a walking castle in the roguelike action game Castlebound
notes.notes:
From Ogre Pixel who made Lonesome Village and A Tiny Sticker Tale, their next game is an action roguelike where you're defending a walking castle. Castlebound seems like it could be a lot of fun.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/03/get-ready-to-defend-a-walking-castle-in-the-roguelike-action-game-castlebound/
